notes: Inactive. The runner treats allow_unattended=false as 'nothing is authorised' and does not launch Claude. To activate work, Build Control commits the prompt (commit A), then commits this file (commit B) with allow_unattended=true, expected_base_commit set to A, and prompt_sha256 set to the SHA-256 of `git cat-file blob A:<prompt_path>`. Set requires_commit/requires_push/expected_report_path to declare what COMPLETED means for that instruction. See build-control/runner/README.md.
